rio.overview: Rio de Janeiro has rugged day hikes within the city limits, climbing through Atlantic Forest to viewpoints over the beaches and bays. The trails are steep and often involve scrambling, and a guide is advised for the exposed rock section of Pedra da Gávea. Pico da Tijuca and Dois Irmãos are shorter climbs, and Pedra do Telégrafo above Barra de Guaratiba is a popular half-day outing.
